description: Predefined and extensible registry of open-source video and audio processing tools.

ingest.name: Ingestion & Stream Downloading
ingest.description: Fetching remote video/audio streams, playlists, and subtitles

probe.name: Inspection & Metadata Probing
probe.description: Rapid analysis of container, codecs, streams, and duration

transcription.name: Speech-to-Text & Subtitles
transcription.description: Extracting spoken audio and generating timestamped text

scene_detection.name: Scene Cut Detection & Frame Sampling
scene_detection.description: Identifying visual transitions, cuts, and slide changes

storyboard.name: Storyboards & Contact Sheets
storyboard.description: Generating single-glance tiled image overviews of video timelines

audio_processing.name: Audio Manipulation & Loudness
audio_processing.description: Separation, normalization, filtering, and silence detection

diarization.name: Speaker Diarization
diarization.description: Distinguishing who spoke when across multiple participants

ocr.name: Visual OCR & Slide Text Extraction
ocr.description: Reading text, diagrams, and terminal commands directly from frames

local_vision.name: Local Multimodal Vision Models
local_vision.description: On-device image and frame understanding via Ollama or llama.cpp

editing_rendering.name: Video Editing & Captions Rendering
editing_rendering.description: Automatic silence removal, caption burning, and timeline composition

tracking.name: Object Detection & Video Tracking
tracking.description: Real-time visual object detection, multi-object tracking, instance segmentation, and pose estimation across video streams

yt-dlp.name: yt-dlp
yt-dlp.description: Leading open-source downloader for YouTube, Twitter/X, TikTok, Loom, and 1000+ sites. Supports instant subtitle harvesting without video download.

streamlink.name: streamlink
streamlink.description: Extracts streams from various services to pipe into players or processing pipelines.

ffprobe.name: ffprobe
ffprobe.description: Universal multimedia stream analyzer; extracts duration, resolution, codecs, and chapters in JSON format in milliseconds.

mediainfo.name: MediaInfo
mediainfo.description: Detailed technical and tag information provider for audio and video files.

ffmpeg.name: ffmpeg
ffmpeg.description: The foundational open-source multimedia workhorse. Handles scene change detection (gt(scene,0.3)), frame extraction, contact sheet tiling, and audio conversion.

scenedetect.name: PySceneDetect
scenedetect.description: Fast content-aware scene cut detector (850+ FPS). Excellent statistical color and edge difference algorithms.
scenedetect.install: uv tool install scenedetect (or run via uvx scenedetect)

omnishotcut.name: OmniShotCut
omnishotcut.description: NeurIPS 2026 Deep Learning SOTA for complex shot boundaries (wipes, dissolves, fades). Heavy PyTorch + checkpoint model.

video-analyzer.name: video-analyzer
video-analyzer.description: Multi-stage frame-by-frame LLM vision analyzer (Llama 3.2 Vision via Ollama) and Whisper audio transcription.
video-analyzer.install: git clone https://github.com/byjlw/video-analyzer && pip install -r requirements.txt

scikit-video.name: scikit-video
scikit-video.description: Legacy NumPy/SciPy video processing wrapper. (Largely superseded by native FFmpeg and PySceneDetect).

vcsi.name: vcsi
vcsi.description: Video Contact Sheet generator that creates beautiful grid sheets with timestamp labels and video metadata headers.

imagemagick.name: ImageMagick (montage)
imagemagick.description: Powerful image composition tool; 'montage' arranges arbitrary keyframe images into annotated contact sheets.

youtube-transcript.name: youtube-transcript
youtube-transcript.description: Public YouTube transcript skill. Fetches timestamped subtitles in milliseconds without downloading video bytes; includes automated fallback to hosted endpoints when datacenter IPs are blocked.
youtube-transcript.install: Bundled in ~/.claude/skills/youtube-transcript or via claude-skills repo

whisper-ctranslate2.name: whisper-ctranslate2
whisper-ctranslate2.description: Fast Whisper speech recognition powered by CTranslate2. 4x faster than reference implementation on CPU/GPU, low memory footprint.

mlx-whisper.name: mlx-whisper
mlx-whisper.description: High-performance Apple Silicon (M-series GPU) accelerated Whisper implementation using Apple MLX.

whisper-cpp.name: whisper.cpp
whisper-cpp.description: High-performance inference of OpenAI's Whisper model in plain C/C++ with no dependencies, optimized for Apple Silicon Metal and Raspberry Pi ARM NEON (tiny/base models run in <200MB RAM).
whisper-cpp.install: brew install whisper-cpp (or build from source with cmake on Raspberry Pi)

whisperx.name: WhisperX
whisperx.description: Whisper with word-level forced alignment using phoneme models and speaker diarization via pyannote.

pyannote-audio.name: pyannote.audio
pyannote-audio.description: Neural toolkit for speaker diarization, speech activity detection, and speaker identification.

tesseract.name: Tesseract OCR
tesseract.description: Industry standard open-source OCR engine for extracting text and slide contents from video keyframes.

auto-editor.name: auto-editor
auto-editor.description: Command-line application that analyzes audio/video volume and motion to automatically cut out silences and dead pauses.

hyperframes.name: HyperFrames
hyperframes.description: Open-source tool that turns web pages, HTML title cards, and timed captions into rendered MP4 videos.

qwen2.5-vl.name: Qwen2.5-VL (Ollama)
qwen2.5-vl.description: Local open-weights vision-language model capable of recognizing slide content, diagrams, and video frame context.

ultralytics.name: Ultralytics YOLO
ultralytics.description: Leading open-source real-time object detection and multi-object tracking framework (YOLOv8/v11). Features fast nano models (yolo11n, ~6MB) running 100+ FPS locally, video tracking CLI ('yolo track source=video.mp4'), and CoreML export.
ultralytics.install: uv tool install ultralytics (or pip install ultralytics)
